nodes.label: Multi-platform single codebase (web, PWA, Android, iOS)
nodes.norm_label: multi-platform single codebase (web, pwa, android, ios)

nodes.label: Habit Streak
nodes.rationale: Non-scheduled days do not break streak (e.g. weekend for Mon-Fri habit); computed by walking backwards until break for performance.

nodes.label: Schedule Mention (@) chip
nodes.rationale: Deleted schedule shows 'jadwal dihapus' chip instead of error.

nodes.label: Goal Item Linking (Untuk goal)
nodes.rationale: One item belongs to exactly one place so it is not double-counted in progress.

nodes.label: Periodic Review (Review Berkala)
nodes.rationale: Review answers are saved as Memo with auto-mention of the goal.

nodes.label: Goal Progress Calculation
nodes.rationale: Chapter progress is average of items; main goal is equal-weight average of chapters including Sepanjang goal.

nodes.label: Local Memo Search
nodes.rationale: Client-side only because the server cannot read encrypted content.

nodes.label: Gimana Data Lo Dijaga (E2EE explainer)
nodes.rationale: Explains E2EE in layperson analogies (safe, key, unlocker) in casual Indonesian.

nodes.label: Local Aggregation (once per range change)
nodes.rationale: Aggregation runs on device, once per range change with cached results, avoiding per-widget rescans.

nodes.label: E2EE Master Key with Layered Unlockers
nodes.norm_label: e2ee master key with layered unlockers
nodes.rationale: One random 32-byte key encrypts all data; wrapped copies per unlocker (OTP, biometric, passkey, recovery key) so losing OTP only requires re-wrapping, not re-encrypting data.

nodes.label: Passwordless Login (Email OTP, Google SSO, biometric, QR)
nodes.norm_label: passwordless login (email otp, google sso, biometric, qr)

nodes.label: Monthly day 29-31 skipped in short months
nodes.norm_label: monthly day 29-31 skipped in short months

nodes.label: Page Decoration Mode (Hias) per screen size
nodes.norm_label: page decoration mode (hias) per screen size
nodes.rationale: Decorations stored per screen size (phone/tablet/desktop) and anchored to elements by percentage position rather than absolute pixels so they follow layout changes.

nodes.label: Delta Sync (queue, LWW, tombstone, cursor)
nodes.rationale: Local write first for instant UI; last-write-wins per record; tombstones propagate deletes; paged delta pull for performance.

nodes.label: Email OTP + Google SSO passwordless login
nodes.norm_label: email otp + google sso passwordless login
